## Live sites

- FlareStamina https://flarestamina.com — Free IELTS Academic platform. 144 timed mocks, AI writing feedback, a speaking lab. Teachers run it with a class.
- AI Lenta https://ailenta.uz — Uzbek AI news wire. 24 sources, LLM summaries on a schedule, every item cites the original. Nobody in the loop.
- Chertma https://chertma.maqsudjon.com — Type ASCII, get correct Uzbek New Latin — ş ç ö ğ. Offline. An open 28-million-row lexicon underneath.
- Nullsample https://nullsample.maqsudjon.com — Music from code. Zero samples, six stems, same seed = same track. Source public.
- Tadam https://tadam.uz — Wedding photos in one album. One QR, no app, no signup. Used at a real wedding the week it shipped.
- KVADRAT https://kvdrt.maqsudjon.com — m² calculator for window grilles. Free-text Uzbek and Russian. Offline, PDF out. Built for the shop I work in.
- Davomat https://davomat.maqsudjon-polatov.workers.dev — Attendance for university group monitors, inside Telegram. 25 students marked in under a minute, offline-safe.
- Chiziq / CHZQ https://chzq.uz — Productised web studio: fixed scopes, fixed prices, live portfolio in an iframe instead of screenshots.
- Pierics https://pierics.com — Daily IELTS vocabulary game. One round a day, no account.
- Minnos https://minnos.cc — 26 English cat idioms, with audio, explained in Uzbek.
- ZED AVLOD School https://zedavlod.uz — Language school in To‘raqo‘rg‘on. English, IELTS, CEFR, Ibrat, DTM. Real results, no invented ones.
- CTN Language Centre https://ctnlc.uz — Tashkent language centre. A1–C1, IELTS intensive, kids, speaking club. Trilingual, one file.
- Payvandchi https://payvandchi.maqsudjon.com — Catalogue for the metal workshop. Grilles, railings, canopies — photographed on the job, not staged.
- Reshotkachi https://reshotkachi.maqsudjon.com — Second grille catalogue, Russian-first, built as a 3D wall of 123 real photos.
- maqsudjon.com https://maqsudjon.com — The lab and the build log. Long-form notes on every ship, in English and Uzbek.
